title: Observer Intelligence Authority Token
description: Time-bounded, scope-bounded authorization derived from evidence. Must be re-validated at Action Authorization time; presence of a prior token is not sufficient.

scope.description: Exact permission or action class this token authorizes (e.g. 'read-status', 'execute-action:shutdown'). Scope expansion requires a new token.

not_before.description: Token is invalid before this time.

not_after.description: Token is invalid at or after this time. Replay after expiry must fail.

evidence_refs.description: Observation Record and/or Reconciliation Record IDs that justify this token. Must remain resolvable.

issuer.description: Component or role that minted the token (must be an Authorizer, not an Observer or Executor).

independence_estimate.description: Effective independent evidence pathways used at mint time (optional but recommended).

risk_bound.description: Declared downside or risk context under which the token was issued.

method.description: Integrity binding over (token_id|scope|not_before|not_after|evidence_refs|issuer). 'dev-none' is allowed only in non-production test harnesses and must force an authority penalty.

value.description: MAC or signature value. Action Authorization must recompute/verify.

reconciliation_ref.description: Optional pointer to the Reconciliation Record that produced this token.
